why_use_section.title: Why We Engineer with Flutter
why_use_section.subtitle: Flutter provides a unique combination of development velocity and hardware-accelerated performance.
paragraphs: We utilize Flutter to bridge the gap between native performance and cross-platform efficiency. By leveraging the Skia and Impeller rendering engines, Flutter bypasses traditional bridge-based bottlenecks, allowing us to deliver 60fps to 120fps animations that feel indistinguishable from native code.

The use of Dart—a client-optimized language—ensures strong type safety and state-of-the-art developer tools like 'Hot Reload,' which allows our team to iterate on features in seconds, significantly reducing the overall development lifecycle.
